meta.intro: SafePay Guardian held-out test set. Written and run once AFTER the engine was frozen (prompt 2026-11-10.2, config 2026-11-10.2) and never used for tuning: results are reported as they come out. 58 cases are written for this project from scam patterns published by the FTC and the FBI (each cites its source) plus everyday payments; 11 are real text messages from a public research dataset (8 labelled smishing, 3 labelled ham), copied verbatim except for repairing encoding damage (a lost pound sign or space, HTML entities).
meta.tuning_note: - These cases were written after the engine was frozen and were never used for tuning: misses are reported as they came out, not fixed.
